body: DAT HOLDS A SHAPE ONLY FOR AS LONG AS IT IZ ANGRY

origin: IT CAME UP A CAPPED WELL AN' HAB BEEN COMIN' UP EVER SINCE!
IT WAZ A RESERVE ON A BALANCE SHEET BEFORE IT WAZ A CREATURE!
NOTHIN' DRILLED IT; IT DRILLED ITSELF!

IT HAB BEEN UNDER DA GROUND LONGER DEN DERE HAB BEEN A GROUND!
SOMETHIN' DOWN DERE IZ REFININ', AN' DIS IZ WHAT IT EXPORTS!
IT IZ WHAT A LEASE LOOKS LIKE WHEN IT IZ FINALLY CALLED IN!
epithet: WHO NO CAN BE FLARED OFF

build: SOMETHIN' DA WORLD MADE ONCE AN' DID NO MAKE AGAIN!
A BODY ASSEMBLED OUT OF PARTS NO SINGLE SPECIES OWNS!
IT IZ DA WRONG SIZE FOR EVERYTHIN' AROUND IT, AN' ALWAYS HAB BEEN!

IT READS AS AN ORDINARY ANIMAL UNTIL YOU HAB WATCHED IT FOR A WHILE!
A SHAPE DAT LOOKS DRAWN FROM A DESCRIPTION RATHER DEN FROM LIFE!
IT CARRIES DA PROPORTIONS OF THREE CREATURES AN' DA MANNERS OF NONE!

habit: IT KEEPS TA GROUND NOBODY CROSSES TWICE!
IT MOVES AT DA HOUR DA MAPS IZ NO BEING DRAWN!
IT HAB BEEN WALKIN' DA SAME LINE ACROSS DA CONTINENT FOR YEARS!
IT GOES WHERE IT IZ GOING AN' DOES NO STOP TA BE LOOKED AT!
IT IZ NEVER FOUND WHERE IT WAZ LAST REPORTED!
IT WALKS IN DA OPEN AN' IZ SOMEHOW NEVER IN ANYBODY'S WAY!
IT GRAZES, HUNTS OR WAITS, AN' NO TWO WITNESSES AGREE WHICH!
IT KEEPS A DISTANCE DAT NEVER CHANGES, WHATEVER DA DISTANCE WAZ!
rumour: THREE PEOPLE HAB WRITTEN IT DOWN AN' NO TWO ACCOUNTS AGREE!
EVERY SIGHTIN' IZ SOMEBODY'S ONLY SIGHTIN'!
DA LAST PERSON TA SEE ONE STOPPED TRAVELLIN' AFTERWARDS!
IT IZ IN ONE FIELD GUIDE, IN DA MARGIN, IN PENCIL!
DERE IZ A REWARD POSTED FOR A PHOTOGRAPH AN' NOBODY HAB CLAIMED IT!
DA VILLAGE DAT NAMED IT HAB SINCE NAMED IT SOMETHIN' ELSE!
IT HAB A LOCAL NAME IN FOUR LANGUAGES AN' A PROPER ONE IN NONE!
WHOEVER MEETS IT IZ DA LAST PERSON WHO WILL!

biology: ITS CHEMISTRY IZ NO EARTH'S AN' DOES NO PRETEND TA BE!
IT IZ SYMMETRICAL ALONG AN AXIS NOTHIN' HERE IZ SYMMETRICAL ALONG!
WHAT IT USES FOR BLOOD RUNS AT A TEMPERATURE NOTHIN' HERE SURVIVES!
IT BREATHES SOMETHIN', AN' DA SOMETHIN' IZ NO AIR!
ITS BODY REPEATS ONE ORGAN UNTIL DA REPETITION IZ DA ANIMAL!
IT HAB SENSE ORGANS FACIN' DIRECTIONS DAT OUGHT NO TA MATTER!
NOTHIN' ABOUT IT IZ WARM, AN' NOTHIN' ABOUT IT IZ SLOW!
IT GREW INTO WHATEVER SHAPE ITS GRAVITY WOULD ALLOW!
behaviour: IT ANSWERS MOVEMENT RATHER DEN SOUND!
IT HUNTS ON A SCHEDULE KEYED TA A DAY NOBODY HERE IZ LIVIN'!
IT HAB NO REACTION TA BEING LOOKED AT. DAT IN ITSELF TELLS YOU SOMETHIN'!
IT TREATS A LANDIN' PARTY AS WEATHER!
IT IZ TERRITORIAL ABOUT GROUND IDENTICAL TA ALL DA OTHER GROUND!
IT SWARMS, DEN DOES NO, AN' DA CHANGE HAB NO VISIBLE CAUSE!
IT TRAVELS IN A FORMATION DAT HOLDS TA DA CENTIMETRE!
IT IZ WAITIN' FOR SOMETHIN' DAT HAB NO HAPPENED YET!
world: IT WAZ CATALOGUED ON DA FIRST LANDIN' DAT SURVIVED ONE!
ITS WORLD IZ LISTED AS HABITABLE, WHICH IZ A CLERICAL OPINION!
IT IZ DA ONLY THING DAT MOVES FOR A HUNDRED KILOMETRES!
DA BIOSIGNATURE PROMISED SOMETHIN' LIKE DIS AN' UNDERSTATED IT!
IT BELONGS TA A WORLD DAT HAB NEVER HAB A VISITOR TWICE!
NOTHIN' ELSE ON ITS PLANET SHARES A SINGLE FEATURE WIT IT!
DA SURVEY DAT NAMED IT WAZ CUT SHORT!
IT IZ, AS FAR AS ANYBODY CAN PROVE, NATIVE!
